notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
Good day to all. I would like to inform you that the work on the project does not stand still and is actively moving. Alas, it is not moving as fast as I would like, but in any case, the main thing is not worth it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43887148/90b66e0f3f79d85405271736e228ffc42141f426.gif[/img]

Right now I have two main areas of work: creating a high quality and accessible demo for everyone, and updating the game teaser. The current teaser of the game is quite outdated and I'll be honest, it was made in haste.

[previewyoutube=KgJ7Hw1XF1E;full][/previewyoutube]

I want to tell you a little bit about what I plan to implement in the demo version of the game. Players will be given an introductory chapter of the game, in which it will be possible to explore the apartment building where the game's protagonist Alex lives. Several floors of the building will be available for exploration, where you will have to solve a couple of simple puzzles on the way to Alex's apartment. There you will be able that the hero has his own skeletons in the closet. And ends the demo on a very unexpected twist, which I hope will interest you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43887148/7e3105e7cef09e58dc5a51c4be4e4d38b75fd0d9.gif[/img]

And in closing, I want to say thank you to all those who add to the game in wishful thinking. There aren't many of you, but each and every one of you has made a huge difference. Seeing that people are really interested in the game gives me the energy to work on it. I will do everything to make sure it comes out and that it comes out with quality. 
Thanks again and good luck to all of us.
